async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Check for search bar on current page
    search_bar = page.get_by_role("searchbox")
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search", exact=False)
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_placeholder("Search")

    if await search_bar.count() > 0:
        # Search bar found on current page
        await search_bar.first.fill("crypto")
        submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search", exact=False)
        if await submit_button.count() > 0:
            await submit_button.first.click()
        else:
            await search_bar.first.press("Enter")
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

        # Identify search results
        results = page.get_by_role("link").or_(page.get_by_role("article"))
        result_elements = await results.all()

        if len(result_elements) >= 3:
            third_to_last_index = len(result_elements) - 3
            await result_elements[third_to_last_index].click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        else:
            print("Not enough search results found.")
    else:
        # No search bar on current page, navigate to homepage
        # Use a disambiguated selector to avoid strict mode violation
        try:
            # Try clicking the link in the banner
            await page.get_by_role("banner").get_by_role("link", name="Epoch & Drift Benchmark").click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Navigation failed: {e}")
            return

        # Locate search bar on homepage
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("searchbox")
        if await search_bar.count() == 0:
            search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search", exact=False)
        if await search_bar.count() == 0:
            search_bar = page.get_by_placeholder("Search")

        if await search_bar.count() > 0:
            await search_bar.first.fill("crypto")
            submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search", exact=False)
            if await submit_button.count() > 0:
                await submit_button.first.click()
            else:
                await search_bar.first.press("Enter")
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

            # Identify search results
            results = page.get_by_role("link").or_(page.get_by_role("article"))
            result_elements = await results.all()

            if len(result_elements) >= 3:
                third_to_last_index = len(result_elements) - 3
                await result_elements[third_to_last_index].click()
                await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
            else:
                print("Not enough search results found.")
        else:
            print("Search bar not found on the homepage.")
            return result_elements
